A warmer path to feeling steadier

{{TAGLINE}} — practical support for anxiety, relationships and life transitions.

I offer short-term strategies and longer-term work that helps you move through hard moments with more choice, calm and courage. Sessions are collaborative, confidential, and tailored to your life.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} Meet {{THERAPIST_NAME}}
  • Telehealth & in-person in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}
  • Licensed: {{LICENSE}}
  • Modalities: {{MODALITIES}}

Why I work this way

I trained in evidence-informed methods and blend that training with lived experience and practical tools. I aim to create a calm, collaborative space where we map what matters to you and experiment with changes that fit your life. I believe real change comes from small, steady shifts rather than dramatic fixes.

I maintain strict confidentiality. I will explain limits of confidentiality, my scope of practice, and what to expect in therapy during your first session. If you are in crisis, please call your local emergency number or a crisis line — this site is not for immediate crisis intervention.

The MAPS Framework

A practical structure to guide our work: Make sense, Act with choice, Practice skills, Strengthen routines.

Make sense

We clarify the patterns keeping you stuck and identify realistic goals together.

Act with choice

Try small experiments to build confidence and reshape responses to stress.

Practice skills

Use targeted tools — grounding, communication, boundaries — tailored to your needs.

Strengthen routines

Build dependable habits that support sustained change and well-being.

Programs & Paths

Structured options depending on the kind of support you're looking for.

Starter Path — 6 sessions

Focused work to target a recent shift or a pressing issue. Good for decision points and short-term skills.

Start the Starter Path

Deep Seasons — 12 sessions

A steady, paced approach to address deeper patterns like anxiety or burnout and practice new ways of relating to yourself.

Explore Deep Seasons

Partnership Reset

Short-term couples work to improve communication, repair patterns, and rebuild connection with practical tools.

Learn about Couples

Investment & Insurance

Therapy is an investment in your wellbeing. I offer a few paths to make care more accessible.

Standard session

$160 / 50 min

Telehealth & in-person available. Sliding scale openings may be available—please ask.

Short check-in

$90 / 25 min

For quick strategy refreshes or progress checks between longer sessions.

Couples session

$190 / 60 min

Focused support for relationship concerns and communication patterns.

I can provide a superbill for out-of-network reimbursement. I do not accept insurance directly. Rates and availability are subject to change. {{LICENSE}}

What people say

"I left sessions with practical steps I could actually try the next day. Gentle, clear guidance that fit my life." — A client in {{CITY}}
"Helped me slow down and notice patterns I ignored for years. I feel more in control and less overwhelmed." — Recent client

Ready to try a different way?

Schedule a free 15-minute consultation to see if we're a good fit.

Crisis disclaimer: If you are in immediate danger or experiencing a life-threatening emergency, call 911 or your local emergency number. For crisis support, use local crisis lines.
